name: YeAbbay Serawit
description: Daily news analysis and political commentary show featuring expert guests and in-depth discussions on current affairs affecting Ethiopia and the Horn of Africa.

name: Ethiopian Idol
description: Music competition showcasing Ethiopia's best vocal talent. Weekly episodes feature performances, judge commentary, and audience voting.

name: Zemen
description: Historical drama series set in the medieval Ethiopian empire. Follows the lives of royalty, warriors, and common people during a turbulent period.

name: Science & Innovation
description: Weekly show exploring technological advancements and scientific discoveries in Ethiopia. Features interviews with researchers and demonstrations.

name: Comedy Hour
description: Stand-up comedy featuring Ethiopia's top comedians. Each episode features multiple comedians performing their best material.

name: Health Today
description: Medical information program featuring doctors and health experts discussing common health issues, prevention, and treatment options.
